description: Update an existing IMAP account. Useful for fixing SMTP settings without removing and re-adding the account.

accountId.description: ID of the account to update

allowStartTLS.description: When tls is false, set to false to also disable imapflow's opportunistic STARTTLS upgrade (see imap_add_account). Defaults to true.

defaultBcc.description: Optional BCC address(es) applied automatically to every outbound message for this account. Pass an empty string to clear

saveToSent.description: Save sent emails to the Sent folder

sentFolder.description: Explicit Sent-folder name for saving sent-mail copies (e.g. "Gesendet"). Overrides auto-detection; pass an empty string to clear the override and re-enable auto-detection. Check names with imap_list_folders

smtpPassword.description: SMTP password (if different from IMAP password)

smtpPort.description: SMTP port (465 for SMTPS, 587 for STARTTLS)

smtpSecure.description: Use implicit TLS (SMTPS). Port 587/25 always use STARTTLS regardless

smtpUser.description: SMTP username (if different from IMAP user)

name: imap_update_account
